content:
Hey guys, glad to inform that I have passed the ADIT Pillar Two Award by the Chartered Institute of Taxation (CIOT). It is the first time that such an award has been offered - rather timely, given all the movements in the Pillar Two space these days. 

Even better - 3 of my close friends also made it - Tuhin Chaturvedi, MSc, FCA, ACA, Zaheer Ahmed - Tax Agent - Pillar Two and Amrita Lathigra. Along with so many wonderful friends and acquaintances who cleared various facets of their ADIT exams too! Congratulations to all.

This exam was all the more worth remembering because until the last moment, I was not even sure if I could sit for it - and Zaheer Ahmed - Tax Agent - Pillar Two in particular really pushed me over the line (respect, bro!).

It is available for sitting again in December (see this https://lnkd.in/deDsQ8Fb). And always, please feel welcome to reach out for any insights on prepping the exam.

Thank you Chartered Institute of Taxation (CIOT). Appreciate your support.
comment: Pillar Two expertise will be valuable as rules move from design to implementation; the bigger challenge may be aligning tax, finance and data teams to produce reliable calculations across jurisdictions.
